trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. It is the last trophy any run earns, after the 100% checklist and every side goal are done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story trophy and unlocks as the campaign begins.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay, and meditate at home before moving on, for the one missable trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The chapter trophy lands when the last mission of the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progress only; nothing to hunt down for this one.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Keep the chapter-start save until the chapter is done.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. One more save before the finale is cheap insurance, since there is no replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist has 35 tasks and needs roughly 60% of true completion — 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied — but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be finished in full. Open Progress, then Stats, to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts build up across free roam, so fold them into normal driving — jumps, near misses and air time all count — and watch the counter climb.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Anything on the activities list counts — a race, a round at the range, a fishing challenge — so sample them as you meet them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's par pattern first, then chase gold one challenge at a time; the counter tracks how many are golded.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location is its own race — a win anywhere counts toward that spot.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replays of the same race do not count; work through the race list and tick off new ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him in the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and play a game through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Andy. Clear Andy's stranger strand to the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Kenton. Clear Kenton's stranger strand to the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Billy. Clear Billy's stranger strand to the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each stranger has a strand of missions; finish any 8 of them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Randy. Clear Randy's stranger strand to the end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Tyrone. Clear Tyrone's stranger strand to the end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The home spot is only open during Chapter 1 — meditate there before the chapter ends, or it is gone for good, since there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 as insurance.
trophies.missNote: The home meditation spot is only available during Chapter 1 and disappears when the chapter ends. Meditate at home first, before leaving Chapter 1, and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests mark the animal — track it down and take it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — sweep region by region and the sets fill in.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The counter ticks up at each WAiNK spot; work through them district by district.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat and exploration, and they stack up across a normal playthrough — check the challenge list for what is left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner — keep the wanted level alive between robberies and do not let it drop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count the first time you get in or scan them — the 100% checklist counts 200 of 277, so keep discovering past this trophy.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a tight group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport and leave by an unscheduled route — any departure that is not a booked flight.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Tied to the Rhino tanks. The exact trigger is not confirmed in the launch guides, so this one stays unconfirmed rather than guessed — check the sources for updates as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses — and get out clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault is its own job; escape cleanly after each one and the counter climbs.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the take, and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive every district and the last fogged corners appear.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang counts; work through the gang list.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. The exact spot is not pinned down in the launch guides, so try the beachfront bars first.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. A story-set-piece moment — drive out through the showroom front.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: No reliable unlock method is published yet — the description gives no concrete trigger, so this one stays unconfirmed rather than guessed. Check the sources as players work it out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500. Choices across the story and free roam add up; the counter climbs as you decide.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No reliable unlock method is published yet — the description gives no concrete trigger, so this one stays unconfirmed rather than guessed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No reliable unlock method is published yet — the description gives no concrete trigger, so this one stays unconfirmed rather than guessed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the launch guides.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Laundered money counts toward the total — work the contacts until the counter hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — it adds up across the whole run.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market and the trophy lands.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles through the app until the counter hits 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
